newsitem.title: UK: Kansai Electric Power to set $500 mln 10-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: Kansai Electric Power to set $500 mln 10-yr bond.

text.p: Kansai Electric Power Co Inc will launch a $500 million 10-year bond in the near future, joint lead managers Merrill Lynch International and Paribas Capital Markets said in a statement on Wednesday.
Sources away from the lead managers said the deal was likely to come in the low-30s basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
"I expect Kansai Electric will pay around 33 b.p. over Treasuries," a syndicate official at a Japanese bank here said.
In April Kansai Electric Power issued a 3.0 billion French franc 10-year bond, also via Merrill and Paribas. The deal was launched at 15 b.p. over government bonds.
